stock.description: Operating as an investment holding company, AMCO United Holding Limited engages in a variety of business ventures. Its primary activities include the international manufacturing and distribution of medical equipment and plastic molded goods, catering to markets in Hong Kong and globally. The firm further extends its services to the construction sector, undertaking building projects, maintenance and improvement works, project management, and both renovation and decoration services. Complementing these operations, AMCO United also provides money lending facilities and strategically invests in marketable securities. The company, established in 1994, adopted its current name, AMCO United Holding Limited, in February 2012, having previously traded as Guojin Resources Holdings Limited. Its headquarters are situated in Central, Hong Kong.
